task.summary_zh: 依 SD §12/§13.1 與 specs/agora/trading_event.schema.json 做 trading room aggregate 與 entry/add/reduce/exit/review 事件佇列,§17.4 endpoint;事件欄位(confidence/probability/EV/rationale/riskNotes/evidenceRefs/invalidation)對齊 schema。 【有疑問一定要提出,不要自己亂做】動工前先讀完引用的設計稿(SD 對應章節 + docs/04/pantheon_agora_cross_repo_2026-06-20/design-closure/ + canonical services/control-plane/specs/agora/*.schema.json / openapi/agora_v1.openapi.yaml / capability_manifest.json)。只要遇到任何疑問、不確定、設計稿沒寫到、與既有 code 對不上、依賴不清、無法重現或衝突,一律 STOP,用 blocker(或向 reviewer handoff)把問題具體寫出來並等待澄清,絕對不可自行臆測、補洞、繞過或先做再說。可動工的部分必須與引用 spec/schema 逐欄位一致:不得自創 schema/欄位/評分/widget/route、不得擴張 capability allowlist、不得讓 Agora 直接下單/綁資金/寫 RuntimeBinding。
acceptance: trading room aggregate 與事件佇列符合 trading_event.schema.json;§17.4 endpoint 到位;附測試;【驗收】實作與引用 spec/schema 逐欄位一致,無自創欄位/route/enum;遇疑問須先開 blocker 澄清而非自行實作;自行臆測或偏離設計稿一律不通過

handoffs.message: Implementation complete: trading room aggregate + decision event queues per design-closure-round2 doc 04 and v4 schemas. 18/18 pytest pass. Commit ae65237f on task/AG-BE-TR-001. Key files: trading_room/router.py (models + 9 routes), trading_room/store.py (in-memory store), trading_room/test_trading_room.py (18 tests). Safety invariant: no_order_route_proof enforced on all decision events and intent handoffs. Governed intent handoff stubs present; AG-BE-TR-002 owns full implementation.

Review not approved. Required fixes: (1) schema-valid responses: TradingDecisionEvent.model_dump currently emits null optional fields (dedupe_key/candidate_ref/subject.asset_class/etc.) that violate v4 JSON Schema when present; serialize with exclude_none or otherwise match schema and add jsonschema regression. (2) enforce no_order_route_proof at store/router boundary: TradingRoomStore.upsert_decision_event accepts BROKER_ORDER_ALLOWED and list/detail return it unchanged, violating D1 safety invariant. (3) fix pagination token semantics: next_page_token currently repeats the previous page's last item (e0,e1 -> token e1 -> e1,e2); add regression. Focused pytest still passes: python3 -m pytest services/control-plane/bff/agora/trading_room/test_trading_room.py -v (18 passed). Branch also needs compose with current origin/dev before approval/closeout.

All three required fixes are implemented. (1) model_dump(exclude_none=True) on aggregate + 2 jsonschema regressions; (2) store.upsert_decision_event raises ValueError on invalid/missing no_order_route_proof + 2 regressions; (3) pagination offset fixed to start+1 + 2 regressions. 24/24 tests pass. Branch merged with origin/dev at e73d1dcd. Commit: 667a7abd. Please re-review and approve so we can proceed to closeout.
